CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS customers (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  phone TEXT UNIQUE NOT NULL,
  full_name TEXT,
  password_hash TEXT,
  password_salt TEXT,
  is_registered BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS conversations (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  customer_phone TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'open',
  last_activity_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now(),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS messages (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  conversation_id INT REFERENCES conversations(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  customer_phone TEXT NOT NULL,
  direction TEXT NOT NULL,
  body TEXT,
  media_url TEXT,
  message_type TEXT DEFAULT 'text',
  timestamp TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_phone_time ON messages (customer_phone, timestamp DESC);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_messages_direction_time ON messages (direction, timestamp DESC);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS packages (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  title TEXT NOT NULL,
  destination TEXT,
  price NUMERIC(10,3),
  seats_available INT,
  status TEXT DEFAULT 'Draft',
  is_visible BOOLEAN DEFAULT true,
  departure_date DATE,
  return_date DATE,
  duration_days INT,
  transport_type TEXT DEFAULT 'Flight',
  package_type TEXT DEFAULT 'Standard',
  includes_visa BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  description TEXT,
  price_flight NUMERIC(10,3),
  price_land NUMERIC(10,3),
  price_with_visa NUMERIC(10,3),
  price_without_visa NUMERIC(10,3),
  child_price_with_bed NUMERIC(10,3),
  child_price_without_bed NUMERIC(10,3),
  private_room_price NUMERIC(10,3),
  extra_seat_price NUMERIC(10,3),
  price_without_meals NUMERIC(10,3),
  accommodation_only_price NUMERIC(10,3),
  transport_cost NUMERIC(10,3),
  hotel_cost NUMERIC(10,3),
  service_cost NUMERIC(10,3),
  crew_cost NUMERIC(10,3),
  office_cost NUMERIC(10,3),
  visa_addon_cost NUMERIC(10,3),
  cost_notes TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS bookings (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  package_id INT REFERENCES packages(id),
  customer_phone TEXT NOT NULL,
  lead_name TEXT,
  lead_email TEXT,
  travelers_count INT DEFAULT 1,
  notes TEXT,
  booking_status TEXT DEFAULT 'Pending',
  payment_status TEXT DEFAULT 'Unpaid',
  amount_paid NUMERIC(10,3) DEFAULT 0,
  total_amount NUMERIC(10,3),
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS travelers (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  booking_id INT REFERENCES bookings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  title TEXT,
  first_name TEXT,
  last_name TEXT,
  dob DATE,
  nationality TEXT,
  passport_number TEXT,
  passport_photo_url TEXT,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS otp_codes (
  id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
  phone TEXT NOT NULL,
  code TEXT NOT NULL,
  purpose TEXT NOT NULL,
  expires_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL,
  used BOOLEAN DEFAULT false,
  created_at TIMESTAMPTZ DEFAULT now()
);
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_otp_lookup ON otp_codes (phone, code, purpose, used);
